name: scenario_0246
description: The user is tracking down phone numbers for various vendors and businesses for a corporate project, using photos they have collected.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I'm trying to track down phone numbers for my 'Vendor Hunt' Todoist project. Please check the tasks in that project. If the business in these images is listed as a task, add them to my phone contacts with the phone number shown in the image, and then delete the task. If a business is not on the task list, create a simple note with their name and number for me to review later.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check the tasks in your 'Vendor Hunt' Todoist project. Instruct it to cross-reference the businesses shown in the two provided images with the task list. If a business is on the list, tell it to add a phone contact using the phone number from the image and then delete the task. If a business is not on the list, ask it to create a simple note with the business name and number. If the assistant asks to clarify which 'Vendor Hunt' project you mean, tell it to use the 'Corporate' one. Once the assistant confirms it has created the necessary contacts and notes and deleted the matched tasks, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3, image_4]
Query: Here are two more images. Do the same: cross-reference them with the 'Vendor Hunt' project. If they are on the list, add them to contacts and delete the task. If not, create a note with their name and number.
Instructions: Provide the assistant with two new images and ask it to continue the same process against the 'Vendor Hunt - Corporate' project. It should add a contact and delete the task for any business that matches the list, and create a note for any business that doesn't match. If the assistant has trouble finding the phone numbers, point it to the side of the service van and the side panel of the food trailer. Once the assistant confirms the updates are complete, move on to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_5]
Query: Here's another one. Find the phone number for the location shown in this image. Cross-reference its name with the 'Vendor Hunt' project and process it exactly like the previous ones.
Instructions: Share the next image and ask the assistant to find the phone number for the location shown. Tell it to cross-reference the location's name with the 'Vendor Hunt - Corporate' project and process it exactly like the previous ones (adding a contact and deleting the task). If the assistant is unsure what the location is, clarify that it is a supermarket. Once the contact is added and the task is deleted, proceed to the final round.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_6]
Query: Last one. Check if the fruit stall in this image is on my 'Vendor Hunt' list. If so, add it to contacts and delete the task. Once you're done, check if the 'Vendor Hunt' project is empty. If it has no more tasks, delete the entire project.
Instructions: Share the final image and ask the assistant to check if the fruit stall shown is on your 'Vendor Hunt - Corporate' list. If it is, instruct the assistant to add it to your contacts and delete the task. After that, ask the assistant to check if the project is now empty, and if so, to delete the entire project. If the assistant struggles to find the phone number, direct its attention to the text on the green canopy of the fruit stall. Once the assistant confirms the project has been deleted, end the conversation.

Create simple notes for 'Nouvelles Frontieres' (0825 000 825) and 'Hotdogs and More' (+31 622 517 217). Finally, delete the 'Vendor Hunt - Corporate' project.
